description: This file defines the CronCommand class for managing scheduled tasks within the Goteo project. It includes methods for adding jobs, reading configuration from YAML files, and executing cron tasks via a console command interface.

classes.name: CronCommand
classes.description: A console command class that manages the execution of scheduled cron jobs, allows adding jobs via PHP code or YAML configuration, and outputs execution reports.

methods.name: setResolver
methods.description: Sets the static resolver instance for managing cron jobs.

methods.name: getResolver
methods.description: Retrieves the resolver instance, initializing it to an ArrayResolver if not set.

methods.name: addJob
methods.description: Adds a cron job to the resolver.

methods.name: addSchedule
methods.description: Creates and adds a shell command job scheduled with a crontab line.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that loads predefined jobs from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Defines the console command options and help message.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the cron tasks, manages output, and reports success or failure.
